_source: AstroLock's own optics/sensor database. Bare facts (sensor resolution + pixel pitch, optic focal length + aperture) compiled from manufacturer spec pages and the underlying image-sensor datasheets. No shared lineage with any other project's data. 'sensors' = camera image chips (ZWO cameras are keyed by the Sony/Aptina/Panasonic sensor inside; MC=color w/ Bayer mosaic, MM=mono). 'optics' = telescopes + photo lenses. 'reducers' = focal reducers / barlows (multiplier on focal length). Plate scale / field of view is computed in astrolock/seeker/optics.py.
